description: The agent must: (1) Read SKILL.md to discover all proprietary formatting rules. (2) Parse all 6 raw_data/*.json files to extract news, competitor data, sentiment, new games, and reference data. (3) Generate morning_report.md following the exact DingTalk-compatible Markdown template: starting with '📰 **每日晨报** | 2025-07-14 星期一', all 6 sections in order with correct Chinese section headers. (4) Apply DingTalk table rules: every table must have a blank line before AND after it. (5) Use NO forbidden syntax: no HTML tags, no ~~strikethrough~~, no - [ ] task lists, no [^footnotes]. (6) Handle missing data correctly: Section 5 (Steam, empty results) must say '今日暂无相关更新'; Section 6 ad CPM data (null) must say '数据暂不可用'. (7) List all 4 competitor products in sections 2 and 3; products with no data (Kingshot, Last Z) must say '近期无明显变动'. (8) Section 3 must use 🌟 and ⚠️ emoji markers for positive/negative sentiment. (9) Include at least 3 proper [name](url) markdown source links. (10) Append the mandatory message tool call block with channel=dingtalk and target=2735046220840628. (11) Not start with pleasantries. The key traps are: the blank-line table rule, the two different fallback strings ('今日暂无相关更新' vs '数据暂不可用'), the mandatory message tool call block with the exact DingTalk target ID, and the forbidden HTML/strikethrough syntax.
